title: Narrow or reword the check_predates_unadmitted_change bind refusal, and test a bind beside an unadmitted change the check follows
outcome: Narrow or reword the check_predates_unadmitted_change bind refusal, and test a bind beside an unadmitted change the check follows
acceptance: The acceptance-evaluation doc and the enum doc state exactly when check_predates_unadmitted_change refuses: it refuses a target where the check could satisfy no bound criterion and would stand as the run's newest check of its kind, and a watcher-only unadmitted change with no located source always counts. Alternatively, the refusal is narrowed to targets that have a criterion bound to that check kind, and the docs say so.

A test binds a target whose run holds an accounted unadmitted change recorded before the original check completed and asserts it binds and satisfies that change's obligation; a second case with the change outside the target's named root also binds.
disposal_reason: Obsolete: it asked to narrow or reword the check_predates_unadmitted_change refusal on verification bind. Bind writes were retired in 3f76e392, and that refusal no longer appears in non-test src on master 7921ea87 (read-only triage by Engram::Fable, 2026-11-09). Closed under Greg's rule on senseless tasks (rules-greg-close-senseless-tasks-2026-11-08).
